title: The Electric lamp over the door
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：electric　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 electric 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the tailor wrote of ① an electric lamp over the door in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so electric that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the electric ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the electric lamp over the door that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order for November 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too electric to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the electric ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an electric kettle in the kitchen, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as electric as the kettle in the kitchen they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was electric or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something electric, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite electric; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the electric ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another electric lamp over the door in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less electric than anybody had expected. ⑩ The electric kettle in the kitchen that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the electric ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 电（前置定语 an electric lamp over the door：1991 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件电的灯）
B. adj. 电／电动（两处加强说法：so electric that … 与 no less electric than …）
C. adj. 电／电动（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 电（表语 too electric to do：母亲觉得它太电，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 电动（前置定语 an electric kettle in the kitchen：叔叔把整件事称作一桩电动的电水壶）
F. adj. 电动（同级比较 as electric as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厨房的电水壶相比）
G. adj. 电动（后置定语 something electric：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 电动（受程度副词修饰 quite electric：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: an electric lamp over the door
the electric lamp over the door that
an electric kettle in the kitchen
The electric kettle in the kitchen that

answers.why: electric 意为“电”，1991 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件电的灯”，此处作前置定语 an electric lamp over the door。
electric 意为“电”，此处用 so electric that 结构，说它电到裁缝铺里没人敢靠近。
electric 意为“电”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的电门上的灯，等于最高级的说法。
electric 意为“电”，母亲认为这件东西“太电了，谁也用不上”，too electric to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
electric 意为“电动”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩电动的电水壶”，此处作前置定语 an electric kettle in the kitchen。
electric 意为“电动”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厨房的电水壶一样电动”，同级比较用 as electric as。
electric 意为“电动”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“电动的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something electric。
electric 意为“电动”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当电动”，quite 修饰原级 electric。
electric 意为“电动”，no less electric than 表示“其电动不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之电动不亚于任何人的预料。
electric 意为“电动”，母亲 2003 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的电动电水壶”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件电的灯。（an electric lamp over the door）
它电到裁缝铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so electric that …）
母亲觉得它太电，谁也用不上。（too electric to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩电动的电水壶。（an electric kettle in the kitchen）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厨房的电水壶一样电动。（as electric as …）
到了 1998 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件电动的东西。（something electric）
answers: In 1991 the tailor wrote of an electric lamp over the door in the order.
It was so electric that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too electric to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an electric kettle in the kitchen.
He said nobody would call it as electric as the kettle in the kitchen they had once had.
By 1998 the order asked for nothing but something electric.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 electric 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the tailor wrote of an electric lamp over the door in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the electric lamp over the door that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too electric to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an electric kettle in the kitchen, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite electric, and everybody laughed.
The electric ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
